note: Registry of recorded-event catalogues (data contract §6). No catalogue has been delivered: every entry is `pending` and every recorded-event result is `data_required`. A pending entry is a delivery slot, not data; there are no event files in this directory and an absent file is never read as 'zero events'.

aggregation_rule.catalogue_selection: One approved catalogue per phenomenon, region and analysis: the `ready` catalogue with the lowest `priority` number that has a delivery for the region. Records of different catalogues are never concatenated.
aggregation_rule.deduplication: By `event_id` inside the selected catalogue; by `canonical_event_id` only when the catalogue declares `canonical_ids: true`, i.e. the cross-catalogue mapping and de-duplication policy were prepared upstream. A repeated key counts once.
aggregation_rule.region_rule: An event counts once for a region listed in its `region_ids`; the region mapping is delivered with the catalogue and is not rebuilt at query time.
aggregation_rule.year_attribution: An event belongs to the calendar year of its start and is counted once, also when it lasts into later years or crosses a boundary of the analysis period. If the source precision leaves the start year undetermined, the candidate years are missing.
aggregation_rule.time_precision: Source precision is kept (year / month / day / time). A coarse record is an interval; no day or time of day is invented.
aggregation_rule.duration: Inclusive calendar days, exact only when both ends are known to the day. Coarser records carry [min, max] bounds from their uncertainty intervals and make the annual duration sum missing. An event without an end is flagged `ongoing` and has no duration.
aggregation_rule.zero_rule: A year without events is zero only if it lies wholly inside coverage declared `complete` and no known gap touches it. `partial` / `unknown` coverage, known gaps, years cut by the coverage boundary and regions without a coverage record are missing (null).
aggregation_rule.analysis_period_rule: Only calendar years lying completely inside the analysis period enter an annual trend. Events that began before the period are listed with censoring `left` and are not counted again inside it.
aggregation_rule.severity_rule: Annual severity is computed only for a catalogue whose `severity_metric.annual_aggregation` is one of `severity_annual_aggregations`; any other declared aggregation gives `not_applicable` instead of a sum.

metrics.label: Recorded events starting per year
metrics.rule: Number of catalogue events of the region that start in the calendar year (see aggregation_rule.year_attribution and zero_rule).

metrics.label: Recorded event duration per start year
metrics.rule: Sum of the exact durations (inclusive calendar days) of the events starting in the calendar year; missing if any of them has no exact duration.

metrics.label: Recorded event severity per start year
metrics.rule: Sum of the catalogue's registered `severity_metric` over the events starting in the calendar year; unit and definition come from the catalogue. Not available when the catalogue registers no severity metric; missing if any event of the year lacks the value.

catalogues.label: Recorded flood events (delivery slot)
catalogues.reason: No flood event catalogue has been delivered. Flood frequency, duration and severity are data_required; monthly precipitation is not a substitute.

catalogues.label: Recorded drought events (delivery slot)
catalogues.reason: No drought event catalogue has been delivered. Recorded drought events are data_required; the derived SPI indicators are reported separately as derived_indicator.
